<thought>Using the available functional groups, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks an acyl‑chloride‑type group (which includes sulfonyl chlorides) and forms a sulfonamide. This should return the template ID(s) that can be applied to the target molecule to generate its precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
